remarks: Desirable end unit in popular Wilton Condo Association. Light and bright, this 2 bedroom, 2 bath unit has a spacious living and dining room area with a kitchen, full bath and main floor bedroom which can also be used as an office space. Upstairs you find a primary bedroom with full bath and large closet. Other features of the unit include central air, garage, storage space plus a pool in the complex! Village Walk provides in town living at its best! Train station, Library, Norwalk River Valley Trail, Restaurants, Grocery Retailers, Pharmacy, Public Bus Service and more! All within walking distance. Great opportunity to live in Wilton!
